purpose: Translations for already resolved German lemmas/POS only; display only, never used for resolving.

release_asset.note: zip of the source JSONL; the JSONL inside is byte for byte the file above

supplement.attribution: German Wiktionary contributors; extracted via Wiktextract / Kaikki.org.
supplement.rule: translation tables («Übersetzungen») of German entries, only for word + part of speech without a translation in the main source
supplement.record_ids: 1000000 + line number in the supplement file
supplement.record_field: record.source = tr.wiktionary | de.wiktionary; de senses: data.glosses = synonyms joined with ", ", data.sense_number = sense number of the German entry, data.definition_de = its German definition

attribution: Turkish Wiktionary (Vikisözlük) contributors; extracted and postprocessed via Wiktextract / Kaikki.org. German Wiktionary contributors; extracted via Wiktextract / Kaikki.org.
conversion_notice: Translation projection and partitioning; source texts and selected fields preserved byte for byte. Display annotations (status, labels, name_like, reflexive, reading, transitivity, syntax, shown; record gender, source_pos, adverbial) added; original JSONL unchanged.
shown: sense.shown[i] = display text of glosses[i] when it differs from the gloss: the pack-language part only (the Turkish of an abbreviation, without a leading label or a final full stop); a gloss with nothing to show repeats the sense's text (the reader shows each text once).

projection.omitted: All unlisted entry/sense fields (forms, sounds, etymology, relations, categories, topics, notes). Original JSONL remains the complete source.
projection.identity: 1-based JSONL record_id plus 0-based sense_index; source sense.id is not unique.
projection.case_policy: Exact source spelling retained (all NFC). No lowercase alias index.

routing: FNV-1a 32-bit over exact UTF-8 key bytes; hash & 1023

labels.field: sense.labels = [[gloss_index, 0, [codes]], ...]; labels come from separate source fields, the gloss has none (cut 0). labels.display = code -> {kind, rude, label}: the Turkish label to show (one per code), kind style / region / domain, rude group or null.

pos_policy._rule: fixed rules first (source pos + pos_title word); then groups looked up in the English dictionary: first preferred POS present for lower(word), else default

corrections._note: 1024-1 (27.11.2026): reviewers A, B and reconciler C — clear source errors only; de_*: German Wiktionary part, keyed by record_id and the German sense number
